desktop.description: Built web application bundle; requires a web server and an independently operated Kingdom service.

iso.description: Debian live-build hybrid boot ISO with XFCE desktop, maximized Centipede browser window, and free everyday apps.

live-usb.description: Same hybrid ISO bytes with a USB-specific filename, validated byte-identical and writable to USB media.

vm.description: QEMU qcow2 disk image converted from the bootable live image and structurally checked.

android.description: Capacitor Android application; stable release requires the project's Android signing secrets.
android.reason: Stable APK publication is disabled until the project configures and protects its Android signing keystore, pins ANDROID_EXPECTED_CERT_SHA256, and enables CENTIPEDE_ENABLE_SIGNED_ANDROID_RELEASE.

ios.description: Capacitor iOS device app; stable device distribution requires Apple distribution signing and provisioning. TestFlight upload is outside this workflow.
ios.reason: Stable iPhone IPA publication is disabled until Apple distribution signing/provisioning credentials are configured; simulator build is validation only.

docker.description: Built and smoke-tested Docker image exported as a loadable image tar archive.
